Description

Who is Defined.ai? Well, from a technical point of view, we leverage the power of a global crowd to provide some of the world’s biggest companies with the high-quality data they need to power their artificial intelligence. We’re instrumental to the progression and development of artificial intelligence and we couldn’t be prouder or more inspired to be involved in an industry that is changing the world.

From a personal point of view, we’re a group of big thinkers, high achievers and creative problem solvers. We bond over our shared love of software engineering, data science, and strong coffee. We like online gaming, running marathons, and team drinks. We celebrate authenticity and diversity and we’re invested in what we do. Our mission? World domination, obviously!

Who are we looking for?

We're looking for someone with prior customer-facing experience as well as knowledge of the data needs of speech, NLP, computer vision or other AI applications.

The candidate will be participating in the proposal lifecycle of data collection, annotation and evaluation projects, and will be gathering requirements from our clients and collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders to propose solutions and develop effort estimates. These solutions will involve the Defined.ai platform, datasets and tools, as well as 3rd party resources available.

This position will be integrated into the Pre-Sales Team and will support the pre-sales process by participating in client meetings as a technical expert, assisting in the identification and elaboration of solutions that fulfill our customer needs. Through deep product and industry knowledge, the candidate will be expected to provide trusted expertise and vision both internally and with our customers.

What you will do?
• Support pre-sales effort for data collection, annotation and evaluation projects, as well as end-to-end solutions.
• Collaborate with clients to identify business challenges and provide appropriate solutions.
• Translate client use cases into data requirements and AI solutions.
• Stay up to date on market trends and competitive insights.
• Setting up costing / pricing for the proposed solutions.
• Support the sales team in closing deals by gaining the clients trust with your deep knowledge and clear solutions.
• Be the creator and owner of the Solution Architecture document and related artifacts.
• Suggest improvements to the Defined.ai product lines based on your insights, client requests and feedback.

Requirements
• Minimum 3 years of experience in relevant roles.
• Degree in AI-related fields (Speech Recognition, Computer Vision, Robotics, Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics, ...) or Data (Data Engineers).
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills (fluency in English is a must).
• Ability to work in a collaborative environment in different time zones and out of working hours when needed.
• Ability to critically analyze and focus on problem solving.
• Hands-on, technically strong, commitment to quality delivery and sense of ownership.
• Familiarity with scripting languages (python, R), database systems (SQL, NoSQL) and distributed data platforms.
• Have an understanding of ASR, NLU, TTS or Computer Vision.

Benefits

You spend a lot of your time at work, so it should be challenging, fun and interesting. At Defined.ai it will be all of those things and more. Here’s what we offer:
• Flexible working schedule and hybrid model. We know comfort can boost creativity and performance, so you can manage your schedule and work both from one of our modern office spaces or home.
• Excellent career development opportunities in a high growth company. With us, you can accomplish your career goals and follow a well-described career path with the support of your supervisor.
• Culture of feedback and continuous improvement. AI is a fast-paced area, so we keep track of tech trends, and we always ask for feedback.
• An international and diverse team. We have more than 30 nationalities at our 3 locations, and we provide language classes.
• Continuous training opportunities. You can choose from many options: leveraging hand-on workshops, unlimited access to Udemy and formal development opportunities.
• We love to have fun together. We joke a lot, and we can't imagine work without fun activities – we already surfed, raced carts and played soccer together.

About Us

Defined.ai offers a platform with multiple data delivery options that leverages machine learning technology and human intelligence to deliver quality-guaranteed training data for AI systems. The platform offers self-service and fully customizable solutions that deliver high-quality project-specific training data, enabling AI products reach market quicker. It is this business model that has allowed Defined.ai to raise a total of $63.6M in funding over 4 rounds. Our value proposition is quality, privacy, speed and scale, covering more than 50 different languages. With strong expertise in speech and natural language processing technologies, we have been serving AI companies and Fortune 500 companies since day one. Defined.ai was founded in Seattle and has offices in Lisbon and Porto.

Job Summary:

Capital One invites you to apply for the position of Senior Distinguished Engineer for AI Systems. In this role, you will contribute towards the development and strengthening of our enterprise's AI capabilities. You'll be part of a team of skilled AI researchers and engineers, and will collaborate with them in solidifying our organization's distributed training clusters, secure infrastructures, and cutting-edge AI research projects. To excel in this role, we are looking for candidates who have expertise in cloud computing, machine learning, and distributed computing, with a strong desire to drive innovation in the banking industry.

• Develop a robust infrastructure to manage demanding training processes employing containers and checkpointing resources.
• Designing and deploying an infrastructure capable of serving large machine learning models efficiently is paramount to achieving success in our public cloud environment.
• With proper deployment and optimization of a training cluster consisting of 1000 nodes in the public cloud, while focusing on the optimization of storage and networking stack, training tasks can be executed at a significantly faster rate.

• I possess an impressive 3 years of experience in the complete lifecycle of machine learning development, working with AI and ML frameworks, along with the public cloud.

Our mission at Capital One is to create trustworthy, reliable and human-in-the-loop AI systems, changing banking for good.
